newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African government names new treasury committee.
newsitem.headline: S.African government names new treasury committee.

text.p: The South African government announced changes to the treasury committee, which meets twice a year to consider departmental requests for additional funds.
Cabinet secretary Jakes Gerwel said the changes follow the withdrawal of F.W. de Klerk's National Party from the government of national unity at the end of June.
The committee previously comprised deputy presidents de Klerk and Thabo Mbeki, Reconstruction and Development Minister Jay Naidoo and Finance Minister Trevor Manuel as chairman.
De Klerk surrendered his position when he left the cabinet and Naidoo was named Minister of Post and Telecommunications in a cabinet shuffle that saw the RDP post dropped.

The cabinet approved a new line-up comprising Manuel as chairman, Mbeki, Home Affairs Minister Mangosuthu Buthelezi, Trade and Industry Minister Alec Erwin, Deputy Finance Minister Gill Marcus and Labour Minister Tito Mboweni.
The committee has in the past approved only clearly unavoidable overruns generally totalling less than two percent of the original budget.
